plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction rejects letters in quantity

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case configuration.
Set the event type to an auction with the standard reverse-auction ranking configuration.
Provide the mandatory event title required for a create test.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and enter the invalid letters value in its quantity field.
Assert that the quantity field rejects the non-numeric value immediately after the Tab/entry validation.
